study type: Diagnostic accuracy study / Prediction model development
cohort: The study included 632 amniotic fluid samples from 169 dichorionic twin and 147 monochorionic twin gestations.
finding: Gestational age and the amniotic lamellar body count were significant independent factors affecting neonatal RDS/TTN, and their combined use resulted in higher diagnostic accuracy for predicting these conditions compared to using LBC alone.
cross-section timing: Amniotic fluid samples were obtained at Cesarean section.
gest_age: Gestational age (GA) was measured as a predictive factor, but specific ranges or means are not provided.
